options.skyboxify.title: Skyboxify Configuration
options.skyboxify.showOverworldForUnknow: Will show the overworld skyboxes in unknown dimensions. Will not show in nether/end though unless a skybox defines it.
options.skyboxify.renderSunMoon.tooltip: Enable/disable rendering of the sun and moon.
options.skyboxify.renderStars.tooltip: Force enable rendering of stars when a Skybox resource pack is enabled & active.
options.skyboxify.debug.tooltip: Enable debug logging & other debugging aspects.
